messages:
emma (DevEx): heads up — onboarding CI started failing for ruby/sample-sdk after a typegen regen this morning. changelog auto-bumped a minor even though diff looks like ordering-only. anyone seen this pattern?
raj (codegen): seen similar. recent typegen change introduced a new stable-sort for params which can reorder examples. that can ripple into the generated changelog and trigger a semver guard.
emma (DevEx): ugh. CI shows a semver guard failure on publish step: `changelog vs last-release` check. the diff is tiny but the automation treats it as a public API change.
jordan (infra): test logs look flakey too: `sampleapp_auth_retry_test` timed out in ruby run, but node/python runs passed. timeout at 120s vs expected 30s.
maya (SDK lead): interesting — auth/retry parity has been a recurring footgun for ruby. double-checking: are we canonicalizing header order in the signed request? ruby client historically sends `Authorization` before `Content-Type` which some mocks treat as different for deterministic examples.
raj (codegen): example diff snippet: ```diff
-  parameters: ["user_id", "session_id"]
+  parameters: ["session_id", "user_id"]
```
raj (codegen): that sort of change will flip the generated examples order -> example hashes change -> changelog entries reorder -> semver check flags it.
emma (DevEx): CI link: <https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/98765|build 98765> — failing step `publish-sdk:changelog-guard`.
ci-bot: build 98765 failed on step `publish-sdk:changelog-guard`. See logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/98765/logs
emma (DevEx): reaction :eyes:
maya (SDK lead): proposed mitigation: 1) patch typegen to enforce a canonical param sort for examples only (non-breaking), 2) add a regen CI job that runs `typegen --stable-examples` and verifies no semver bump, 3) a short-term fix: pin the typegen commit used for ruby SDK publish to avoid automatic minor bumps.
raj (codegen): i can open a PR to add an explicit sort by param name for example generation and add a comment so it's clear. will also add an option `--stable-examples` to the CLI.
jordan (infra): until that lands can we gate the publish job to allow a manual override? add a `PUBLISH_SKIP_SEMVER_GUARD=true` env guarded by a patch approval.
maya (SDK lead): i'll volunteer to open the SDK PR to pin typegen in the ruby sample and add a note in the release checklist. also will update the sampleapp test to be less timing-sensitive (increase timeout / mock auth server determinism).
emma (DevEx): can we also add an integration test that asserts header ordering doesn't change generated examples? tiny test but would catch this earlier.
raj (codegen): yep — adding a unit test for example hash stability and an e2e regen check in the typegen CI.
jordan (infra): i'll add a temporary CI gate to skip the publish step for builds from the `onboard/samples` branch until the hotfix merges.
maya (SDK lead): checklist: - open typegen PR (raj) - pin typegen in ruby sample (maya) - add regen-check CI (raj) - loosen sampleapp timeout and mock (maya/jordan) - add integration test for header ordering (raj)
emma (DevEx): thanks all — assigning owners in the thread. please paste PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
